A '''Fluorescent globe''' was a device used to produce illumination.<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] of the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Units]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] had fluorescent globes for each table.<ref name="MedStar I" />
